Report judge evidence or assess an explicit policy

Source: R/report.R
report.Rd

Without policy, this function renders descriptive evidence and returns the decision "NOT_ASSESSED". It never infers that missing bias or stability evidence passed. With an acceptance_policy(), every criterion is rendered as PASS, FAIL, NOT_ASSESSED, or INDETERMINATE.

Usage

report(
  x,
  bias = NULL,
  stability = NULL,
  policy = NULL,
  output = c("console", "md")
)

Arguments

x

A yourhonor_calibration object.

bias

Optional result from probe_bias(), probe_position(), or combine_bias().

stability

Optional result from test_retest().

policy

Optional policy from acceptance_policy().

output

Default rendering when the report is printed: "console" (styled cli output) or "md" (Markdown lines).

Value

A yourhonor_report list with elements decision (one of PASS, FAIL, INDETERMINATE, NOT_ASSESSED), checks (a tibble with one row per policy check: check, status, value, op, threshold, and reason), the supplied calibration, bias, stability, and policy, and the default output. The report is returned visibly, so calling report() at the console renders it.

Details

The result is the same object whichever output is chosen; output only sets how it prints by default. print(x, output = "md") or format(x, output = "md") render the Markdown form of any report, and as.character() always returns the Markdown lines.

Examples

gold <- tibble::tibble(
  human_label = c("C", "C", "P", "I", "C", "P", "I", "C"),
  judge_label = c("C", "C", "C", "I", "C", "P", "P", "C")
)
cal <- calibrate_judge(gold, label_levels = c("I", "P", "C"),
                       n_boot = 200, seed = 1)
rep <- report(cal, output = "md")
rep$decision
#> [1] "NOT_ASSESSED"
rep
#> ## Judge evidence (n = 8 of 8)
#> 
#> Assessment: **NOT_ASSESSED**.
#> 
#> Agreement with humans: **gwet_ac1 = 0.65** [0.25, 1.00] (substantial).
#> 
#> ### Per-class evidence
#> 
#> - `I`: support 2, precision 1.00, recall 0.50
#> - `P`: support 2, precision 0.50, recall 0.50
#> - `C`: support 4, precision 0.80, recall 1.00
#> 
#> Bias probes: **NOT ASSESSED**.
#> Test-retest stability: **NOT ASSESSED**.
#> 
#> ### Assessment checks
#> 
#> - **NOT_ASSESSED** `acceptance_policy`: No acceptance policy was supplied; evidence is descriptive only.
